figurative_meaning_en: Eyes that water easily, referring to someone who is overly sentimental or cries at the slightest provocation
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঝাঁঝরাচোখের মানুষকে সহজে ধোঁকা দিতে পারব না।
তার ঝাঁঝরাচোখ দেখে বুঝলাম সে খুব সেন্টিমেন্টাল।
example_sentences_in_english: You can't fool me with your teary eyes.
Her watery eyes show she's very sentimental.
note: Idiom highlights emotional expressiveness in Bengali culture
